method: Source-free reconstruction of samples, fixture-specific metadata, fixed work snapshots, summary values and pair directions. No project summarizer/auditor imports; no Dart workload.
limitations: At 25 samples, derived nearest-rank p99 is each process maximum, not reliable percentile-tail evidence.
Only aggregate physical-work snapshots and oracle pass records are retained; per-sample work or complete geometry outputs are not serialized.
Short control workloads in fresh JIT processes include warmup/compilation/host variability; timing movement is not causal attribution to the unexecuted rounding routine.
